name: JSNS2
full_name: J-PARC Sterile Neutrino Search at J-PARC Spallation Neutron Source
summary: JSNS2 tests the LSND appearance anomaly using the same muon-decay-at-rest source and inverse-beta-decay interaction, with the pulsed J-PARC source providing strong timing-based background rejection.
physics_targets: Muon-antineutrino to electron-antineutrino appearance near an eV-squared mass splitting
Carbon and neutrino cross sections at tens of MeV
detection_principle: Electron antineutrinos are sought through inverse beta decay on hydrogen. A prompt positron scintillation signal is followed by gamma rays from neutron capture on gadolinium. Beam timing and pulse-shape discrimination suppress cosmic and fast-neutron backgrounds.

results.summary: Published a first electron-neutrino flux measurement with the carbon charged-current reaction, providing an experimental flux constraint for the oscillation programme.
